guide.summary: A broth eater that spends energy making an enzyme that turns protein into broth.
guide.biology: Some microbes release enzymes outside their bodies that break proteins into smaller pieces that dissolve in water.
guide.rules: Eats broth only; cannot eat protein directly. When protein is in or beside its cell and it has more than 35 energy, it releases protein enzyme at 0.40 energy per second. The broth that enzyme makes is free for anyone nearby to eat, including Creambud and Traplace. Moves 0.25 cells per second and senses food, and protein it could convert, up to 2 cells away.
guide.example: Put Brothmakers on a protein patch next to Creambuds and see whether the Creambuds grow too.
